note: Add to Calendar Date Augmenter implements ONE date_augmenter plugin (id 'addtocal', class AddToCal) that injects Google / iCal (Apple) / Outlook 'add to calendar' links into a date field's rendered output. It defines no plugin type (it consumes date_augmenter's type), no admin page (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush. Persistent state = the plugin's settings stored as field-formatter third-party settings under the date_augmenter key: core.entity_view_display.<e>.<b>.<mode> -> content.<field>.third_party_settings.date_augmenter.instances = {status:{addtocal:bool}, weights:{order:{addtocal:{weight}}}, settings:{addtocal:{label,event_title,location,description,icons,max_desc,ellipsis,past_events,target,ignore_timezone_if_UTC,retain_spacing}}} (schema date_augmenter.plugin.addtocal). Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config on node.article.default: introspection reads back configured settings; execution enables the augmenter (and sets settings) on a datetime field's formatter, verified against the live entity_view_display. NOTE: core datetime_default does not itself invoke augmenters, but the config storage is schema-valid and is exactly where the setting lives; a real render needs a date_augmenter-aware formatter such as Smart Date.

evals.prompt: What does the addtocal_augment (Add to Calendar Date Augmenter) module provide on a Drupal 11 site, and which calendar targets does it generate links for? How is it different from a standalone add-to-calendar field formatter?
evals.expected_output: It implements a single Date Augmenter plugin (id 'addtocal') that injects 'Add to calendar' links (Google Calendar, iCal/Apple, Outlook) into the output of any date formatter that supports the Date Augmenter API (e.g. Smart Date), instead of being a standalone formatter. So you keep a rich date formatter and add calendar links to its output, with no external JS library.

evals.prompt: There's no settings page for addtocal_augment. How do I turn it on for a date field and where are its settings stored?
evals.expected_output: There is no configure route. On the entity/bundle Manage display, open the date field's formatter settings (a formatter that supports the Date Augmenter API) and enable 'Add to Calendar Links' in the Date Augmenter section. It is stored as field-formatter third-party settings: core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> content.<field>.third_party_settings.date_augmenter.instances (status.addtocal true + settings.addtocal).

evals.prompt: In the addtocal_augment plugin settings, which option makes the links appear as a single button that opens a modal dialog instead of an inline list, and which option controls whether links show for events that already happened?
evals.expected_output: The 'target' setting = 'modal' shows a single link that opens a modal (and attaches the addtocal_augment/modal library); '' (default) shows a list of links. The 'past_events' boolean controls whether the widget renders for events whose end time is in the past (default false hides them).

evals.prompt: On this site, the Article content type has a Date/time field with the addtocal (Add to Calendar) Date Augmenter enabled on its display formatter. Inspect the live default view display for Article and tell me the configured links label and whether the links are shown as a list or a modal.
evals.expected_output: The addtocal augmenter on field_atc_known has label 'Save the date' and target 'modal' (single link opening a modal): in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_atc_known component's third_party_settings.date_augmenter.instances.settings.addtocal has label='Save the date', target='modal'.

evals.prompt: For that same Article Date/time field with the addtocal augmenter, inspect the live configuration: what event location is configured, and are add-to-calendar links shown for past events?
evals.expected_output: The configured location is 'Berlin Convention Center' and past_events is true (links show for past events): settings.addtocal.location='Berlin Convention Center', settings.addtocal.past_events=true on field_atc_known in node.article.default.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a Date/time field field_atc_task whose display uses the 'Date and time' (datetime_default) formatter, but the addtocal (Add to Calendar) Date Augmenter is not enabled on it. Using addtocal_augment, enable the addtocal Date Augmenter on that field's formatter in the default view display, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_atc_task component carries third_party_settings.date_augmenter.instances.status.addtocal = true (enable the addtocal augmenter on the field's formatter and save).

evals.prompt: On the Article Date/time field field_atc_loc, use addtocal_augment to enable the addtocal Date Augmenter on its default-display formatter and configure the generated calendar event's location to 'Main Hall' and the links label to 'Add to my calendar'. Apply it to the live view display.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_atc_loc component has third_party_settings.date_augmenter.instances.status.addtocal = true and settings.addtocal.location = 'Main Hall' and settings.addtocal.label = 'Add to my calendar'.
